from pocket_coffea.lib.cuts import MultiCut, Cartesian
from collections import OrderedDict

# Define jet multiplicity binning (JetGood)
jet_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="nJets",
    cuts=OrderedDict([
        ("4j", lambda x: x["nJetGood"] == 4),
        ("5j", lambda x: x["nJetGood"] == 5),
        ("6j+", lambda x: x["nJetGood"] >= 6),
    ])
)

# Define b-tag multiplicity binning
btag_multiplicity = MultiCut(
    name="nBtags",
    cuts=OrderedDict([
        ("2b", lambda x: x["nBJetGood"] == 2),
        ("3b+", lambda x: x["nBJetGood"] >= 3),
    ])
)

# Create cartesian product of the two binnings
# Produces 6 categories: 4j_2b, 4j_3b+, 5j_2b, 5j_3b+, 6j+_2b, 6j+_3b+
analysis_categories = Cartesian(
    name="analysis",
    cuts=[jet_multiplicity, btag_multiplicity]
)

# Use in configuration
categories = {
    "analysis": analysis_categories
}
